The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana c. 1949
Dear Mr. and Mrs. Turner:
Thank you kindly for the Mass stipend. The Mass has been taken care of.
May God bless you,
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap. Praised be Jesus!
